task_context:
Create minimal pytest setup for tests

Add comprehensive test coverage for `Rubric` and `RubricGroup` classes, and rename the mock LLM client to `MockAsyncOpenAI` for clarity and improved input-output mapping.

This PR significantly expands the test suite, covering core evaluation logic in `Rubric` and `RubricGroup`. During development, a bug was identified in `RubricGroup.score_rollouts` where it incorrectly handles asynchronous calls to `rubric.score_rollouts()`; affected tests are currently skipped and documented. The `MockAsyncOpenAI` client was also refactored to support order-independent, multi-turn input-output mapping, making LLM testing more robust and intuitive. All comments and naming conventions have been updated to be timeless.
observations: @pytest.mark.skip(reason="RubricGroup.score_rollouts has a bug - it doesn't await async rubric.score_rollouts calls")
measurement_holes: changed test candidates and skip-capable sites are not separately counted; changed source lines are a proxy
